name: BRCA1 pathogenic variant
description: Inherited loss-of-function variant in BRCA1.
biological_function: Loss of BRCA1 impairs homologous-recombination repair and creates sensitivity to PARP inhibition.

name: BRCA2 pathogenic variant
description: Germline or somatic loss-of-function variant in BRCA2.
biological_function: Loss of BRCA2 impairs RAD51-mediated homologous recombination.

name: HER2 (ERBB2) amplification / overexpression
description: ERBB2 gene amplification or HER2 protein overexpression.
biological_function: Amplified HER2 drives ligand-independent receptor signalling through MAPK and PI3K pathways.

name: Estrogen receptor (ER) expression
description: Nuclear ER-alpha expression measured by immunohistochemistry.
biological_function: Indicates oestrogen-dependent tumour growth.

name: Progesterone receptor (PR) expression
description: Nuclear PR expression measured by immunohistochemistry.
biological_function: PR is an oestrogen-regulated gene; expression reflects a functional ER pathway.

name: Ki-67 proliferation index
description: Fraction of tumour cells with Ki-67 nuclear staining.
biological_function: Measures tumour proliferative activity.

name: PIK3CA activating mutation
description: Hotspot activating mutation in the helical or kinase domain of p110-alpha.
biological_function: Constitutive PI3K pathway activation.

name: ESR1 ligand-binding domain mutation
description: Acquired ESR1 mutations such as Y537S and D538G.
biological_function: Ligand-independent ER activity associated with resistance to endocrine therapy.

name: TP53 mutation
description: Somatic mutation of TP53.
biological_function: Loss of p53 tumour-suppressor function.

name: PALB2 pathogenic variant
description: Inherited loss-of-function variant in PALB2.
biological_function: Impairs BRCA2 localisation and homologous recombination.

name: CHEK2 1100delC
description: Truncating CHEK2 founder variant c.1100delC.
biological_function: Reduced checkpoint-kinase activity after DNA damage.

name: CA 15-3 (serum MUC1)
description: Serum assay detecting shed MUC1 ectodomain.
biological_function: Circulating tumour-associated glycoprotein.

name: 21-gene recurrence score (Oncotype DX)
description: RT-PCR assay of 16 cancer-related and 5 reference genes.
biological_function: Multigene expression signature summarising proliferation and hormone-receptor and HER2 signalling.

name: 70-gene signature (MammaPrint)
description: Microarray-based 70-gene expression profile.
biological_function: Gene-expression signature associated with distant metastasis risk.

name: PAM50 intrinsic subtype
description: 50-gene classifier assigning intrinsic subtypes (luminal A/B; HER2-enriched; basal-like; normal-like).
biological_function: Classifies tumours by intrinsic molecular subtype.

name: E-cadherin (CDH1) loss
description: Loss of E-cadherin expression or inactivating CDH1 alteration.
biological_function: Loss of adherens-junction cell adhesion; hallmark of lobular histology.

name: EGFR activating mutation (exon 19 deletion / L858R)
description: Sensitising EGFR kinase-domain mutations.
biological_function: Constitutive EGFR kinase activation and oncogene addiction.

name: EGFR T790M resistance mutation
description: Gatekeeper mutation in EGFR exon 20.
biological_function: Restores ATP affinity and confers resistance to first-generation EGFR inhibitors.

name: ALK rearrangement (EML4-ALK)
description: Fusion of ALK kinase domain with partners such as EML4.
biological_function: Constitutively active ALK fusion kinase.

name: ROS1 rearrangement
description: Fusion involving the ROS1 kinase domain.
biological_function: Constitutively active ROS1 fusion kinase.

name: KRAS G12C mutation
description: KRAS codon 12 glycine-to-cysteine substitution.
biological_function: Impairs GTP hydrolysis; mutant cysteine can be targeted covalently.

name: KRAS codon 12/13 mutation
description: Activating KRAS exon 2 mutations.
biological_function: Constitutive RAS signalling downstream of EGFR.

name: NRAS mutation
description: Activating NRAS mutation.
biological_function: Constitutive RAS signalling downstream of EGFR.

name: BRAF V600E mutation
description: BRAF valine-600-to-glutamate substitution.
biological_function: Constitutive BRAF kinase activation of the MAPK cascade.

name: MET exon 14 skipping alteration
description: Splice-site alterations causing MET exon 14 skipping.
biological_function: Loss of the juxtamembrane degradation signal stabilises MET.

name: RET rearrangement
description: Fusion of the RET kinase domain with partners such as KIF5B.
biological_function: Constitutively active RET fusion kinase.

name: PD-L1 (CD274) expression
description: Tumour PD-L1 expression measured by immunohistochemistry.
biological_function: Engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress anti-tumour immunity.

name: Tumor mutational burden (TMB)
description: Number of somatic mutations per tumour or per megabase.
biological_function: Higher mutational load may increase neoantigen burden.

name: STK11 mutation
description: Inactivating STK11 (LKB1) mutation.
biological_function: Loss of LKB1 tumour-suppressor signalling.

name: NTRK gene fusion
description: Fusion involving NTRK1/2/3 kinase domains.
biological_function: Constitutively active TRK fusion kinase.

name: Microsatellite instability-high / mismatch-repair deficiency (MSI-H/dMMR)
description: Tumour phenotype from defective DNA mismatch repair.
biological_function: Elevated mutation rate at repetitive sequences.

name: MLH1 pathogenic variant (Lynch syndrome)
description: Inherited loss-of-function variant in MLH1.
biological_function: Mismatch-repair deficiency predisposing to colorectal cancer.

name: MSH2 pathogenic variant (Lynch syndrome)
description: Inherited loss-of-function variant in MSH2.
biological_function: Mismatch-repair deficiency predisposing to colorectal cancer.

name: APC pathogenic variant
description: Inherited truncating APC variant (familial adenomatous polyposis).
biological_function: Loss of beta-catenin regulation in the Wnt pathway.

name: Carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA)
description: Serum CEA concentration.
biological_function: Tumour-associated glycoprotein shed into blood.

name: Methylated SEPT9 (plasma)
description: Plasma assay for methylated SEPT9 DNA.
biological_function: Tumour-derived methylated cell-free DNA.

name: Multitarget stool DNA test
description: Stool test combining KRAS mutations; NDRG4/BMP3 methylation and haemoglobin.
biological_function: Detects tumour-derived DNA shed into stool.

name: Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
description: Serum PSA concentration.
biological_function: Prostate-specific serine protease released into serum.

name: TMPRSS2-ERG fusion
description: Fusion placing ERG under androgen-regulated TMPRSS2 control.
biological_function: Androgen-driven overexpression of the ERG transcription factor.

name: PCA3 urinary RNA
description: Urinary PCA3 RNA measured relative to PSA RNA.
biological_function: Prostate-specific long non-coding RNA overexpressed in cancer.

name: AR-V7 splice variant
description: Androgen-receptor splice variant lacking the ligand-binding domain.
biological_function: Constitutively active AR transcriptional activity.

name: AR amplification
description: Amplification of the androgen-receptor gene.
biological_function: Increased AR signalling under androgen deprivation.

name: PTEN loss
description: Deletion or inactivating alteration of PTEN.
biological_function: Loss of PI3K pathway restraint.

name: AMACR overexpression
description: AMACR protein overexpression by immunohistochemistry.
biological_function: Overexpressed metabolic enzyme in malignant prostate epithelium.

name: SPOP mutation
description: Mutation in the substrate-binding cleft of SPOP.
biological_function: Altered ubiquitination of SPOP substrates.

name: CDK12 biallelic inactivation
description: Biallelic loss-of-function alterations of CDK12.
biological_function: Genomic instability with focal tandem duplications.

name: ATM pathogenic variant
description: Germline or somatic loss-of-function variant in ATM.
biological_function: Impaired DNA double-strand break signalling.
